_comment: Authored analysis: ownership, lifecycle, refcount and locking judgements that no composer can derive, keyed to the C entities they describe. The structural half of each record (field layout, signatures, footprints, casts) is composed from the CodeQL tables on demand and merged in at read time, so a re-extract rewrites nothing here. Written only by `wavefront <repo> <target> query {types,symbols} --update`; read through wavefront.manifests. Hand-edit at your own risk: `--update` validates a submission against the composed skeleton (unknown field, wrong kind, ptr-invariant violation) and this file does not.

types.name: AVBPrint
types._comment_agent: AVBPrint (FF_PAD_STRUCTURE, 1024 bytes) is caller storage initialised in place by av_bprint_init / av_bprint_init_for_buffer and torn down by av_bprint_finalize (a disposer: frees str when allocated, keeps the struct). Rust holds it behind an av_malloc block (str may point into the struct): BPrintBox = CBox<BPrint, BPrintFinalize> (finalize(NULL) + av_free) for av_bprint_init, and CBox<BPrint, BufferStorage<'b>> (av_free only, borrowing the caller buffer) for av_bprint_init_for_buffer. len/size/size_max are maintained by bprint.c; external writers only shrink len and re-terminate (avcodec.c) or commit av_bprint_get_buffer writes (pngdec.c).

ptr.note: The string buffer, NUL-terminated at min(len, size - 1) whenever size > 0, possibly holding binary data before that. Runtime-conditional ownership: it points at reserved_internal_buffer (av_bprint_init, automatic storage reaching through reserved_padding to the end of the 1024-byte struct; also the size-0 fallback of av_bprint_init_for_buffer), at an av_realloc block the struct owns once av_bprint_alloc grew it (av_bprint_is_allocated: str != reserved_internal_buffer; released by av_bprint_finalize(buf, NULL) or handed out by av_bprint_finalize(buf, &s)), or at a caller buffer from av_bprint_init_for_buffer (borrowed from `other`; is_allocated is then true too, but size == size_max keeps av_bprint_alloc from reallocating it, and finalize must never run on it). NULL after av_bprint_finalize either hands the allocation out or releases it with av_freep when ret_str is NULL; inline storage is not cleared by finalization. Self-referential in the inline case, so an initialised AVBPrint must not move.

types.name: AVClass
types._comment_agent: Review core wave-1 batch-0: published library classes and child_class_iterate results are immutable static descriptors; no class-specific allocator, disposer, or cloner exists. Exception to the previous whole-tree static-only claim: libavfilter/vidstabutils.c:vs2av_log initializes an automatic AVClass with a borrowed caller tag and passes its address through a stack context to synchronous av_vlog. ClassRef must carry the actual descriptor and pointee lifetime. Class::new is Rust-owned immutable storage (local or static); its name is static. No lifecycle representation is missing.

ptr.note: Iterates the static classes of potential children through an opaque void* state the caller initializes to NULL; returns NULL at the end. Called by av_opt_child_class_iterate and av_opt_find2's FAKE_OBJ child search; every in-tree iterator returns pointers to static const AVClass objects (iamf.c, options.c, avfilter.c...).
Returns the next AVOptions-enabled child object of an existing object after prev (NULL starts), or NULL; the child is borrowed from the object. Called by av_opt_child_next.

Usually a static literal in an immutable static class. Exception: libavfilter/vidstabutils.c:vs2av_log builds a stack-local class with class_name = tag borrowed from its caller, valid only during synchronous av_vlog. ClassRef and its string view must be bounded by the actual class/name lifetime, not assumed static. The wrapper accepts NULL names.

Per-instance category callback, preferred by log.c get_category() over the category field (version >= 51.56 gate) and by ffprobe's log callback; takes the object as void* and returns an AVClassCategory by value.

Callback returning the name of an object of the class; called by log.c item_name() (falling back to av_default_item_name when NULL), fftools and tee.c. Takes the AVClass-enabled object as void* and returns a string the object or class keeps alive; never written after the static initializer.

The class's option table: a static const AVOption array terminated by an entry with a NULL name (av_opt_next stops there), or NULL for a class without options. Never allocated, written or freed by any C path; the safe getter scans to the terminator and returns a CSlice of OptionDef handles borrowed for the class's lifetime.

Range query callback with av_opt_query_ranges' signature: on success it stores a fresh av_malloc'd AVOptionRanges (released by av_opt_freep_ranges) in its out slot and returns the component count, which av_opt_query_ranges stores in nb_components. No in-tree class sets it; av_opt_query_ranges falls back to av_opt_query_ranges_default.

types.name: AVClassCategory
types._comment_agent: Field-less enum with no lifecycle: a plain unsigned value (bindgen c_uint). C stores it by value in AVClass.category and returns it from AVClass.get_category / av_default_get_category, unchecked, so any unsigned value can reach Rust (log.c get_category guards >= AV_CLASS_CATEGORY_NB). AV_CLASS_CATEGORY_NB is documented as not part of ABI/API. Wrapped as an open Copy newtype, not a closed Rust enum.

types.name: AVClassStateFlags
types._comment_agent: Field-less bit-flag enum with no lifecycle. Never stored as the enum type: callers combine AV_CLASS_STATE_INITIALIZED into an unsigned state_flags member (FFBitStreamFilterContext, FFFilterContext) located through AVClass.state_flags_offset; opt.c reads it to reject non-runtime options on initialized objects. Any unsigned bit pattern is valid. Wrapped as a Copy bit-set newtype.

types.name: AVEscapeMode
types._comment_agent: Plain C enum, no fields, no lifecycle. Values flow Rust->C only: a by-value `mode` argument of av_escape (avstring.c:323) and av_bprint_escape (bprint.c:264); no struct field, return or out-parameter stores it, so C never hands one back. bprint.c:268-313 maps AUTO to BACKSLASH and treats any unknown value as BACKSLASH. Rust representation: closed Rust enum EscapeMode {Auto, Backslash, Quote, Xml} with an infallible conversion into ffi::AVEscapeMode; out-of-range modes are not representable (they only alias BACKSLASH).

types.name: AVMediaType
types._comment_agent: Plain C enum (UNKNOWN=-1, VIDEO..ATTACHMENT=0..4, NB=5 count sentinel), no fields, no lifecycle. Stored by C in public struct fields (AVCodecParameters.codec_type, AVCodecContext.codec_type, AVCodec.type, AVCodecDescriptor.type, AVFilterPad/filter types), in a C-allocated array (AVDeviceInfo.media_types), returned (avcodec_get_type, av_buffersink_get_type, avfilter_pad_get_type) and taken by value (av_get_media_type_string, whose default case returns NULL for any other value). Users write public fields directly, so C memory may hold any int, NB included. Rust representation: #[repr(transparent)] newtype MediaType over ffi::AVMediaType with associated constants, infallible raw conversions both ways, and CPlainElem (every c_int bit pattern valid) so C arrays read as plain slices.

types.name: AVOption
types._comment_agent: Every AVOption lives in a static const table (no C path writes or allocates one), reached through AVClass.option, av_opt_next, av_opt_find/av_opt_find2: a shared borrow with no lifecycle. default_val is a union discriminated by type: FLAG_ARRAY->arr; CONST, BOOL, FLAGS, INT, UINT, INT64, UINT64, DURATION, PIXEL_FMT, SAMPLE_FMT->i64; DOUBLE, FLOAT, RATIONAL->dbl; string-parsed types->str; q is never read.

ptr.note: Union member, read only when type has AV_OPT_TYPE_FLAG_ARRAY; points at a static const AVOptionArrayDef or is NULL (opt.c: opt_array_sep, av_opt_set_defaults2).
Union member, read only when type is STRING, COLOR, IMAGE_SIZE, VIDEO_RATE, BINARY, CHLAYOUT or DICT (av_opt_set_defaults2, av_opt_is_set_to_default); NULL means no default.
String literal in a static const option table; NULL when an option has no help text.
String literal in a static const option table; NULL only in the table's terminating entry, which av_opt_next never returns.
String literal in a static const option table; NULL when the option belongs to no unit.

types.name: AVOptionRanges
types._comment_agent: Allocated by av_opt_query_ranges / av_opt_query_ranges_default (or an AVClass.query_ranges callback, none in tree) through an out-parameter, released by av_opt_freep_ranges. No dup routine. nb_ranges and nb_components bound the release loop, so no setter may change them or range.

ptr.note: av_mallocz'd array of nb_ranges * nb_components AVOptionRange pointers, laid out component-major (range[nb_ranges * component + index]). Each element is an owned av_mallocz'd AVOptionRange (its str an owned av_malloc string) or NULL; av_opt_freep_ranges av_freep's every element's str, the element, then the array, writing NULL into each slot. NULL only for an empty (zeroed) list.

types.name: AVPictureType
types._comment_agent: C enum (NONE=0, I, P, B, S, SI, SP, BI), no fields and no lifecycle. Stored as an int in public struct fields C users write directly (AVFrame.pict_type, AVCodecParserContext.pict_type, ...), so any int value may appear; av_get_picture_type_char maps unknown values to '?'. Wrapped as a transparent newtype PictureType accepting every value, with named associated constants.

types.name: AVRational
types._comment_agent: Plain by-value pair of ints; no pointer fields, no heap lifecycle. C passes and returns it by value (av_mul_q, av_d2q, ...) and embeds it by value in public structs (AVCodecContext.time_base, AVStream.time_base, AVFrame.sample_aspect_ratio, ...), or in caller arrays terminated by {0,0} (av_find_nearest_q_idx, AVCodec.supported_framerates). Its only constructor is the header inline av_make_q (by value, so it has no pointer-return lifetime record); copying is a byte copy and no routine drops, disposes or clones it. 0/0 is a value C itself produces (zeroed contexts, av_cmp_q's INT_MIN case) and every reader tolerates, so all-zero is a valid value. Wrapped as the ffibox layout type Rational (CZeroable, Copy, Send + Sync as plain data) with RationalRef/RationalMut num/den accessors.

types.name: AVRounding
types._comment_agent: By-value only: AVRounding is never stored in a field, returned, or passed to a callback; it flows Rust->C as the `rnd` argument of av_rescale_rnd / av_rescale_q_rnd (and libswscale's static ops helper). av_rescale_rnd accepts a method in {0,1,2,3,5}, alone or ORed with AV_ROUND_PASS_MINMAX (8192); any other value returns INT64_MIN (av_assert2 is compiled out: ASSERT_LEVEL is undefined in every campaign build). Wrapped as the validity-preserving newtype `mathematics::Rounding` (repr(transparent), private field, TryFrom rejects the rest). No lifecycle.

types.name: AVSampleFormat
types._comment_agent: C enum (int-backed, AV_SAMPLE_FMT_NONE = -1 .. AV_SAMPLE_FMT_NB = 12): no fields, no pointers, no lifecycle. Stored by value in public fields users write directly (AVCodecContext.sample_fmt / request_sample_fmt, AVFrame.format as int, AVOption AV_OPT_TYPE_SAMPLE_FMT targets) and in AV_SAMPLE_FMT_NONE-terminated arrays (AVCodec.sample_fmts), so any int is an observable value; libavutil/samplefmt.c and swresample bound-check with `< 0 || >= AV_SAMPLE_FMT_NB` before table lookups. Wrapped as an open #[repr(transparent)] newtype (SampleFormat) accepting every int; plain element (CPlainElem) for av_malloc arrays.

types.name: av_alias16
types._comment_agent: A union (the composer reports kind=struct for the anonymous typedef'd union) declared __attribute__((may_alias)) for type punning in the AV_RN/AV_WN/AV_COPY/AV_SWAP/AV_ZERO macros. Fields u16 and u8[2] are plain scalars that both cover all 2 bytes, so every bit pattern is valid for every field and reading any field of an initialised object is defined. No pointer fields, no allocation, no teardown, no clone routine: C only ever casts existing storage to av_alias16* (opaque_in footprint) or holds it by value. Lifecycle: none; a by-value, trivially copyable value type, all-zero valid.

types.name: av_alias32
types._comment_agent: A union (the composer reports kind=struct for the anonymous typedef'd union) declared __attribute__((may_alias)) for type punning in the AV_RN/AV_WN/AV_COPY/AV_SWAP/AV_ZERO macros. Fields u32, u16[2], u8[4] and f32 are plain scalars that each cover all 4 bytes, so every bit pattern is valid for every field and reading any field of an initialised object is defined. No pointer fields, no allocation, no teardown, no clone routine: C casts existing storage (Mv, VP8mv, VP9mv, byte buffers) to av_alias32* or holds it by value (exif.c). Lifecycle: none; a by-value, trivially copyable value type, all-zero valid.

types.name: av_alias64
types._comment_agent: Plain-data type-punning union (u64 / u32[2] / u16[4] / u8[8] / f64 / f32[2], 8 bytes, align 8, may_alias). No pointer fields, no refcount, no lock. No lifecycle routine exists: every C user holds it inline as a local or reaches it by casting a naturally aligned buffer pointer (AV_RNA/AV_WNA/AV_COPY/AV_SWAP/AV_ZERO in intreadwrite.h, aes_ctr.c, h264/vp8/vp9 predictors); nothing allocates, frees, clones or disposes it beyond a byte copy. Every member spans all 8 bytes and every bit pattern is valid for each, so all-zero is a valid value and any member may be read after any write. Wrapped as a Copy value type (Rust-owned inline storage) with by-value getters/setters per member.

types.name: av_intfloat32
types._comment_agent: Plain-data union { uint32_t i; float f; } (4 bytes) used only as a local to reinterpret bits (av_int2float / av_float2int, aac, sbrdsp, exr, vf_lut3d). No pointer fields, no refcount, no lock, no lifecycle routine; every bit pattern is valid for both members, so all-zero is valid and either member may be read after writing the other. Wrapped as a Copy value type with by-value getters/setters.

types.name: av_intfloat64
types._comment_agent: C `union av_intfloat64 { uint64_t i; double f; }` (the record's kind says struct; the definition is a union). A type-punning union: no discriminator, both members cover all 8 bytes and every bit pattern is a valid value of each, so either view is always readable after a write to the other (av_int2double writes i and reads f; av_double2int the reverse). No pointer fields, no sub-allocations and no lifecycle routine: C only creates it as an automatic local or a const initializer ({.i = ...} in libavcodec/mips/constants.c, mips-only); copied by value, never freed. All-zero is valid (i = 0, f = +0.0). No shared state or lock: plain data, Send/Sync like u64.

types.name: ff_pad_helper_AVBPrint
types._comment_agent: Review core wave-1 batch-0: ff_pad_helper_AVBPrint is a sizeof-only witness generated by FF_PAD_STRUCTURE. No C path instantiates it, passes it to a bprint routine, owns its pointee, or disposes it. The authored BPrintFields value uses str only as a nullable borrowed immutable C string, with no relationship to len/size/size_max or reserved_internal_buffer. AVBPrint ownership belongs to the separate AVBPrint record, not this helper.

ptr.note: C uses this helper only in sizeof; it has no observed runtime pointer ownership. BPrintFields in the safe Rust surface borrows a NUL-terminated string (static through set_str, or caller-kept through set_str_borrowed), never writes through it, and never frees it. The independent scalar fields do not bound the string or imply allocation. Unlike AVBPrint this is not self-referential and is freely copyable.

types.name: unaligned_16
types._comment_agent: Packed (align 1), may_alias single-member union { uint16_t l; } declared only under __GNUC__/__clang__ (the composer records it as a struct). It owns nothing, has no lifecycle routine, and is never allocated or passed by pointer by any function: its sole use is the AV_RN(16, p) / AV_WN(16, p, v) macros (and AV_COPY16U built on them, e.g. mem.c fill16/fill32/av_memcpy_backptr), which cast an arbitrary (possibly misaligned) byte pointer to (const) union unaligned_16 * and read or store `l` in native byte order for one expression. Field `l` is a by-value scalar: any bit pattern is valid, all-zero included, no lock guards it (callers synchronise the byte buffer they cast).

types.name: unaligned_32
types._comment_agent: Packed (align 1), may_alias single-member union { uint32_t l; } declared only under __GNUC__/__clang__ (the composer records it as a struct). It owns nothing, has no lifecycle routine, and is never allocated or passed by pointer by any function: its sole use is the AV_RN(32, p) / AV_WN(32, p, v) macros (and AV_COPY32U built on them, e.g. mem.c fill16/fill32/av_memcpy_backptr), which cast an arbitrary (possibly misaligned) byte pointer to (const) union unaligned_32 * and read or store `l` in native byte order for one expression. Field `l` is a by-value scalar: any bit pattern is valid, all-zero included, no lock guards it (callers synchronise the byte buffer they cast).

types.name: unaligned_64
types._comment_agent: Packed (align 1, size 8), may_alias (av_alias) union over one uint64_t; no pointer fields and no lifecycle routine. C never allocates or frees it: AV_RN(64,p)/AV_WN(64,p,v) cast an arbitrary byte pointer to `union unaligned_64 *` and read/write `->l` for one native-endian unaligned 64-bit access (the GCC/clang branch of intreadwrite.h). Every toucher (e.g. mem.c fill32, aes.c addkey_*, adler32.c av_adler32_update) does exactly that on caller-owned byte buffers for the duration of one expression; nothing stores or retains the pointer and nothing synchronizes it. Ownership is therefore the byte storage's: a by-value plain datum, or a transient borrowed view over 8 bytes. All-zero and every bit pattern are valid.

ptr.note: Trailing component, read for the call only. NULL makes the result av_strdup(path); both NULL yields NULL.
Leading path, read for the call only. NULL makes the result av_strdup(component).

Fresh NUL-terminated join of path and component with exactly one '/' between them (av_malloc, or av_strdup when one side is NULL); released by av_free. NULL when both are NULL, on size_t overflow or on allocation failure.
printf format, read for the call only (vsnprintf twice); the variadic arguments follow it. Must not be NULL.
Fresh av_malloc(len + 1) block holding the formatted, NUL-terminated string; released by av_free. NULL when vsnprintf fails or allocation fails.
Path, only read (strrchr). NULL and the empty string both yield the static ".".
Never NULL: a pointer into `path` (just past its last '/', or `path` itself) or, for a NULL or empty path, the string literal "." (static). Either way it lives at least as long as `path`.

An initialised AVBPrint (av_bprint_init / av_bprint_init_for_buffer), borrowed mutably for the call only and not retained. When the text does not fit, av_bprint_alloc grows str only while size < size_max and the buffer is complete: an inline string is copied into a fresh av_realloc block the struct then owns, an owned block is av_realloc'd; a caller buffer (size == size_max) never grows. What does not fit is truncated, but len counts it (capped at UINT_MAX - 5); str stays NUL-terminated at min(len, size - 1). Appends min(size, room - 1) bytes of data with memcpy.

`size` bytes read with memcpy for the call only (binary, NULs included, not a string). Only min(size, room - 1) bytes are read, none when the buffer has no room; it must not alias the buffer's own storage, which av_realloc may move. The safe wrapper passes a Rust slice, split into UINT_MAX-byte pieces.

An initialised AVBPrint (av_bprint_init / av_bprint_init_for_buffer), borrowed mutably for the call only and not retained. When the text does not fit, av_bprint_alloc grows str only while size < size_max and the buffer is complete: an inline string is copied into a fresh av_realloc block the struct then owns, an owned block is av_realloc'd; a caller buffer (size == size_max) never grows. What does not fit is truncated, but len counts it (capped at UINT_MAX - 5); str stays NUL-terminated at min(len, size - 1). memsets min(n, room - 1) copies of c.

An initialised AVBPrint, borrowed mutably for the call: when len is non-zero, writes *str = 0 and len = 0 (storage, size and size_max kept; a truncated buffer becomes complete). *str is always writable: str is the inline storage for a count-only buffer (size 0), else size >= 1.

An initialised AVBPrint (av_bprint_init / av_bprint_init_for_buffer), borrowed mutably for the call only and not retained. Appends the escaped text through av_bprint_chars / av_bprintf (see their growth and truncation).
Extra characters backslash mode escapes, read with strchr for the call only; NULL means none (`special_chars &&`). Ignored by the quote and XML modes.
Text to escape, read up to its NUL for the call only. Must not be NULL, and must not point into dstbuf's storage (appends may realloc it).

The AVBPrint being finalized, borrowed: its heap str (when av_bprint_is_allocated) is av_freep'd when ret_str is NULL, or handed to *ret_str and buf->str cleared; buf->size is set to the final size. The struct's own storage is kept (caller-provided).

Optional out slot for the string, an alloc-constructor output (av_free releases it): the shrunk av_realloc heap buffer (or the unshrunk one when that realloc fails), else av_memdup(buf->str, min(len + 1, size)) for an internal/user buffer, NULL with AVERROR(ENOMEM) when that copy fails. NULL slot discards the string. C DEFECT: for an AV_BPRINT_SIZE_COUNT_ONLY buffer (av_bprint_init(.., 0, AV_BPRINT_SIZE_COUNT_ONLY), or av_bprint_init_for_buffer with size 0) size is 0, so the result is av_memdup(str, 0) = a 1-byte av_malloc block that is never written: NOT NUL-terminated (ASan: heap-buffer-overflow in strlen). A wrapper must not adopt that result as an owned string (HeapString). The lifecycle role below is the AVBPrint teardown; the string output is recorded here because the schema carries one role per symbol.

Out slot, written unconditionally: the room size - min(len, size) after any growth, which may be smaller (limit, ENOMEM, truncated buffer) or larger than size; it includes the byte the NUL must keep. Must not be NULL.

An initialised AVBPrint, borrowed mutably: when size > room it calls av_bprint_alloc(buf, size) (same growth rules as the appenders, failure ignored); len is NOT changed: the caller commits what it wrote by raising len and re-terminating (pngdec.c: bp->len += n; bp->str[bp->len] = 0).

Out slot, written unconditionally: str + len, a borrow into buf's string storage (inline storage, owned av_realloc block or caller buffer), valid for *actual_size bytes of writes until the next append, finalize or move of buf; NULL when the room is 0. Bytes past str[len] are uninitialised (av_realloc), str[len] holds the NUL. Must not be NULL.

Caller storage of one AVBPrint, written in place without being read: str = reserved_internal_buffer, len = 0, size = min(automatic size, size_max), size_max (1 replaced by the automatic size), *str = 0; then av_bprint_alloc grows into an av_realloc block when size_init exceeds the inline size (silently keeping the inline buffer on failure). The struct must not move afterwards (str points into it).

Caller storage of one AVBPrint, initialised in place: str = buffer, len = 0, size = size_max = size, *str = 0; with size 0 it delegates to av_bprint_init(buf, 0, AV_BPRINT_SIZE_COUNT_ONLY) (inline, count only).

A caller byte buffer of `size` chars that the AVBPrint stores in str and writes for its whole life (never reallocated: size == size_max makes av_bprint_alloc fail with EIO); it must outlive the AVBPrint and must never reach av_bprint_finalize, which would av_realloc/av_free it since str != reserved_internal_buffer. Not dereferenced when size is 0, so NULL is accepted then.
An initialised AVBPrint, read for the call only (len < size); static inline in bprint.h.

An initialised AVBPrint (av_bprint_init / av_bprint_init_for_buffer), borrowed mutably for the call only and not retained. When the text does not fit, av_bprint_alloc grows str only while size < size_max and the buffer is complete: an inline string is copied into a fresh av_realloc block the struct then owns, an owned block is av_realloc'd; a caller buffer (size == size_max) never grows. What does not fit is truncated, but len counts it (capped at UINT_MAX - 5); str stays NUL-terminated at min(len, size - 1). strftime writes straight into str + len with the room as its limit; a failed attempt (0) may leave unterminated bytes past len, which the retry or av_bprint_grow re-terminates. If growth fails it formats into a 1 KiB local buffer and av_bprintf's it (room < 1024), else fills the room with '!' and "[truncated strftime output]" and forces truncation. Empty fmt returns at once.
strftime format, read (strlen and strftime) for the call only. Must not be NULL.

libc struct tm, read by strftime for the call only; glibc also reads tm_zone (NULL accepted: the local zone name is used) for %Z. Out-of-range fields give unspecified characters (C11 7.27.3.5), not UB; glibc range-checks its name tables. Must not be NULL.

An initialised AVBPrint (av_bprint_init / av_bprint_init_for_buffer), borrowed mutably for the call only and not retained. When the text does not fit, av_bprint_alloc grows str only while size < size_max and the buffer is complete: an inline string is copied into a fresh av_realloc block the struct then owns, an owned block is av_realloc'd; a caller buffer (size == size_max) never grows. What does not fit is truncated, but len counts it (capped at UINT_MAX - 5); str stays NUL-terminated at min(len, size - 1). Delegates to av_vbprintf: vsnprintf into str + len with the room; retries after growing when the text does not fit; a vsnprintf error or empty text appends nothing.
printf format, read for the call; the variadic arguments follow it. Must not be NULL. The safe wrapper formats in Rust and passes the text through "%s".

Array of nmemb elements of size bytes, ZEROED (av_mallocz); also one zeroed object when nmemb is 1 (av_calloc(1, sizeof(RNNModel)) in libavfilter/af_arnndn.c, av_calloc(1, sizeof(*fc->ft)) in libavcodec/vvc/thread.c). NULL also when nmemb*size overflows size_t. Fresh av_malloc storage: posix_memalign(ALIGN) with ALIGN = 64/32/16 by SIMD config (16 is the floor); size 0 yields a 1-byte block, so NULL means failure: size > max_alloc_size (INT_MAX by default, av_max_alloc) or OOM. Released by av_free/av_freep.

An AVClass-enabled object, read for the call only: C loads its first member as `*(AVClass **) ptr` (so it must be aligned for a pointer and hold a non-NULL pointer to a live AVClass) and returns that class's `category` by value. Never written, stored or freed; declared `void *` only for the log.h callback signature.

An AVClass-enabled object: dereferenced as `AVClass **` (the struct's first member is its `const AVClass *`), read only. The inner AVClass is borrowed, static in every in-tree class. Must be non-NULL, as must the class pointer it holds.
The class's `class_name`, returned as stored: it lives as long as the AVClass (a string literal in every in-tree class). NULL only for a class that stores NULL there (none in tree).

Out slot for the serialized dictionary: an empty dictionary gets av_strdup(""), any other av_bprint_finalize's out-string (an av_realloc or av_memdup block); NUL-terminated, released by av_free. NULL slot is rejected with AVERROR(EINVAL), as are invalid separators, before anything is written; *buffer is NULL on ENOMEM.
Dictionary iterated read-only for the call (av_dict_count, av_dict_iterate); NULL counts as empty and yields "".

Caller-owned NUL-terminated path, modified in place: a NUL is written over its last '/' (and, with HAVE_DOS_PATHS, '\\' or the char after ':'). NULL is accepted and yields ".". Nothing is retained. [Symbol: Not a lifecycle primitive: an in-place string cut. Note C's textual semantics: "/usr" -> "" and "a/b/" -> "a/b" (not POSIX dirname). C reaches UB (float-cast-overflow) for '+'/'-' operands at or beyond 2^63 in magnitude (opt.c (int64_t)d: max, inf, 1e300) and for expression tokens such as ld(1e300) (eval.c av_clip of a double). A '+'/'-' operand is truncated, not rounded, and only the combination is range-checked, so fractional operands (+2.5, -0.999) are valid input. The Rust wrapper restricts tokens to [A-Za-z0-9_.], reads a '+'/'-' operand's value through av_strtod (or the evaluators' constants) and truncates and combines it as C does, refusing the overflowing conversion; a CPU-flag name or anything else goes through C's own unprefixed evaluation.

One past the buffer's last byte: compared against the cursor before every read, never dereferenced.

In/out cursor into the caller's byte buffer [*bufp, buf_end): advanced by exactly 1 byte for an invalid lead byte, for a tail byte that is not 10xxxxxx (even when earlier tail bytes were fine: E2 82 41 consumes only E2) and for a sequence cut short by buf_end (E2 82 at the end consumes only E2); by the whole sequence otherwise, overlong and >= 2^31 encodings included (E0 80 80 consumes 3 with *codep untouched); unchanged only for an empty buffer. The inner pointer borrows that buffer. (The cursor slot itself is written; mutable is false because the innermost pointee, uint8_t, is const.)

Out slot, written only once a sequence is well-formed and below 2^31 (also when the flag range checks then fail); untouched for an empty buffer, a malformed or overlong sequence. [Symbol: Returns 0 on success (and for an empty buffer, without consuming), AVERROR(EILSEQ) otherwise.]

An initialised AVBPrint (av_bprint_init / av_bprint_init_for_buffer), borrowed mutably for the call only and not retained. When the text does not fit, av_bprint_alloc grows str only while size < size_max and the buffer is complete: an inline string is copied into a fresh av_realloc block the struct then owns, an owned block is av_realloc'd; a caller buffer (size == size_max) never grows. What does not fit is truncated, but len counts it (capped at UINT_MAX - 5); str stays NUL-terminated at min(len, size - 1). vsnprintf (with a va_copy per attempt) into str + len with the room; retries after growing when the text does not fit; a vsnprintf error or empty text appends nothing.

printf format, read by vsnprintf for the call; vl_arg supplies its arguments and is only va_copy'd, never consumed. Must not be NULL. The safe wrapper reaches it through the crustify_av_vbprintf shim with "%s" and a NUL-terminated string.
Address of the string literal FFMPEG_VERSION: NUL-terminated, immutable, never freed, valid for the process lifetime.
